plugins.name: denisulmer-skills
plugins.description: From a ticket to merged code on Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab or plain git, asking you only what is yours to decide: a spec with testable acceptance criteria written into the ticket, a build criterion by criterion, a 0-100 risk score, review rounds sized by that risk that post one log thread and a thread only where a person is needed, a watched merge, and metrics that show what reviews cost and find.
